plain: Twisted from its proper use or purpose

webster.text: Turned from right to wrong; distorted; corrupted; misinterpreted; misemployed.

example.quote: However, in this imperfect state, we cannot expect to have government formed upon such a basis but that it may be perverted by bad men to evil purposes.
example.cite: Samuel West, A Sermon Preached before the Honorable Council and the Honorable House of Representatives of Massachusetts-Bay, May 29, 1776 (as reprinted in Thornton, The Pulpit of the American Revolution (1860))
